HA_worms_rtp.description: cross-scale persistence of horizontal-gradient maxima of the reduced-to-pole magnetic field, upward-continued 0-8 km

HA_worms_grav.description: same worming operator on the isostatic gravity anomaly

HB_tdr_rtp.description: tilt-derivative zero-contour steepness on RTP magnetics

HB_tdr_grav.description: tilt-derivative zero-contour steepness on isostatic gravity

HC_hinge.description: linear steps in depth-to-conductive-base restricted to topographically flat ground (buried structures only)

HD_strain_raw.description: geodetic 2nd invariant minus earthquake density (fault-density term is added per holdout fold from the VISIBLE catalogue only)

HE_lin_tc.description: oriented matched-filter lineaments in band `tc` (GeoDAWN radiometric total count - see irregularity I-2)

HE_lin_cond.description: oriented matched-filter lineaments in surface conductivity

R6_shore.description: R6-2 paleo-shoreline / lacustrine terrace scarp: curvature ridge on detrended elev gated to flat playa/lake beds

R6_condbase.description: R6-3 conductive-base step: product of depth-to-base and cond gradients, oriented-filtered, anti-topo gated

R6_gravterm.description: R6-4 gravity-gradient termination/intersection: where hg ridge terminates, emit continuation

R6_transt.description: R6-5 transtensional coupling: shear * positive dilatation * 2nd invariant localized by gravity gradient

R6_horse_full.description: R6-1 horsetail splay / relay-ramp (full catalogue version for submission): connects step-overs and fans at tips

R7_crossgrad.description: R7-1 cross-gradient edge: gravity and RTP-magnetic horizontal gradients must be strong AND parallel, at 0/1/3 km continuation

R7_hinge_curv.description: R7-2 maximum-curvature (Laplacian) hinge lines of the conductive-base surface, flat-ground and anti-topographic gated

R7_seis_cross.description: R7-3 cross-gradient edges gated to active seismic corridors (ieq_n100a15 and deq_n100a15)

R7_seis_grav.description: R7-3 gravity-gradient termination rays gated to active seismic corridors

R7_consensus3.description: R7-4 N-of-5 edge consensus: rtp, gravity, conductivity, depth-to-base and TMI must each show an edge within 300 m

R7_consensus4.description: R7-4 stricter N-of-5 edge consensus (4 of 5)

R7_grain_full.description: R7-5 regional structural-grain coherence on RTP where the catalogue is silent (FULL-catalogue version -- submission only, do not sweep this on the holdout; run_holdout3.py rebuilds it per fold)

R8_openness.description: R8-1 openness / sky-view factor for subtle scarps on flat basin floors (illumination-invariant horizon angle, detrended elev)

R8_tpi.description: R8-1b multi-scale TPI (ridge/valley residual on det_elev at 300m/600m/1.2km) for intrabasin scarps

R8_flow.description: R8-2 fault-controlled drainage deflection: D8 flow accumulation anomaly gated to flat ground (hydrologic lineament)

R8_isocoherence.description: R8-3 isostatic coherence breakdown: windowed gravity-topography decorrelation = buried fault-bounded basin (windowed Pearson r)

R8_remanence.description: R8-4 magnetic remanence divergence: RTP vs TMI/mag_anom mismatch (remanent vs induced) highlights fault-juxtaposed volcanics

BASE_topo_ridge.description: BASELINE: topographic scarp/ridge detector on detrended-elevation slope - the family this team has already submitted repeatedly

BASE_tmi_hg.description: BASELINE: single-scale horizontal-gradient ridge on the provided TMI horizontal gradient band

R8_intersections.description: R8-5 fault-intersection density: pairwise intersections of topographic, magnetic worm, cross-gradient & isocoherence ridges, 600m gaussian permeability halo (geothermal vent proxy)
